decisions.reason: A same-message MODIFY already records one ticket for every non-promotional no-referral mint and preserves weighted-draw allocation; no additional change is required.
A same-message MODIFY already records one commission for every non-promotional mint using a referral code.
A same-message MODIFY already revises the FAQ to state that each non-promotional mint creates one commission and one ticket, with referral-free allocations handled by weighted draw.
A same-message MODIFY already establishes one ticket per coded-referral mint and excludes promotional mints.
Commission and ticket quantities do not change which referral identifiers are valid or the prohibition on self-referrals.
The source changes reward coverage and quantity, not the NFT token serial used as the referral identity or where that identity is displayed.
The landing-page mechanics teaser still promises four entries per referral, which directly conflicts with the new one-ticket-per-non-promotional-mint rule.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: The number of commissions and tickets should each equal the number of mints, excluding promotional mints. However, those distributed by weighted draw do not seem to be registering.

value_updates.mechanics_tease_text: A purchase gives the buyer ownership of the book and a referral link. Each non-promotional referral mint pays an instant, unlimited $10 and supplies 1 entry to a $900 random giveaway every 750 sales.

decisions.reason: The metadata requirement governs counter visibility and attribute accuracy, not the number of commissions or tickets generated per eligible mint.
Changing ticket and commission issuance per mint does not alter which NFT properties or active tickets follow the NFT after transfer.
The source does not change email delivery, notification channels, or transactional email contents.
The current About-page state describes Small Block tickets generically and contains no conflicting per-mint ticket or commission quantity.
The source changes commission and ticket occurrence counts but does not change the $30 price, dollar amounts, recipient shares, or prize-pool destination.
